<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Happy Birthday Malkin 💖</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Great+Vibes&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#1a0614;--pink:#ff4fa3;--soft:#ffd1e8;--gold:#ffd27a;box-sizing:border-box}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:#fff;font-family:Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
body{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%,#4a0f3a,#1a0614 70%)}
.screen{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;padding-top:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));padding-bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
.screen.on{display:flex;animation:fade 1s}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.script{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive}
/* lock */
#lock h2{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:300;margin-bottom:6px}
#lock p{color:var(--soft);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:22px}
.dots{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:26px}
.dots i{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--pink)}
.dots i.f{background:var(--pink);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--pink)}
.pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,72px);gap:14px}
.pad button{height:72px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ff4fa377;background:#ffffff0d;color:#fff;font-size:1.5rem;font-family:inherit}
.pad button:active{background:var(--pink)}
.shake{animation:sh .4s}
@keyframes sh{25%{transform:translateX(-10px)}75%{transform:translateX(10px)}}
#msg{height:20px;margin-top:18px;color:var(--gold);font-size:.85rem}
/* hero */
.glow{font-size:clamp(3.2rem,16vw,6.5rem);line-height:1.05;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--pink),0 0 28px var(--pink),0 0 60px #ff0080;animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.glow2{font-size:clamp(2rem,10vw,3.6rem);margin-top:22px;color:var(--gold);text-shadow:0 0 12px #ffb300,0 0 30px #ff8800;animation:pulse 2.4s .6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.75;text-shadow:0 0 20px var(--pink),0 0 50px var(--pink),0 0 90px #ff0080}}
.next{margin-top:44px;padding:12px 30px;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid var(--pink);background:#ff4fa322;color:#fff;font-family:inherit;font-size:1rem}
.heart{position:fixed;bottom:-30px;pointer-events:none;animation:up linear forwards;z-index:5}
@keyframes up{to{transform:translateY(-110vh) rotate(20deg);opacity:0}}
/* swipe feed */
#feed{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;overflow-y:scroll;scroll-snap-type:y mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
#feed.on{display:block}
.pg{height:100vh;height:100dvh;scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:28px;padding-top:calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));padding-bottom:calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
.vid{width:100%;max-width:420px;aspect-ratio:9/14;max-height:72vh;border-radius:20px;border:2px solid #ff4fa366;box-shadow:0 0 40px #ff4fa355;background:#00000066;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.vid video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hint{margin-top:18px;color:var(--soft);font-size:.9rem;animation:bob 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.letter{max-width:460px;background:#fff6fa;color:#4a1233;border-radius:16px;padding:26px 24px;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 0 50px #ff4fa366;max-height:86vh;overflow-y:auto}
.letter h3{font-size:2.2rem;color:#d6246e;margin-bottom:10px}
.letter p{font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:10px}
.wishes h2{font-size:3rem;color:var(--gold);text-shadow:0 0 18px #ffb300;margin-bottom:18px}
.wishes li{list-style:none;font-size:1.05rem;margin:11px 0;color:var(--soft)}
.end .glow{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,12vw,4.4rem)}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="lock" class="screen on">
  <h2 class="script" style="font-size:2.6rem">For Malkin 💗</h2>
  <p>Enter the secret code</p>
  <div class="dots" id="dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
  <div class="pad" id="pad"></div>
  <div id="msg"></div>
</div>

<div id="hero" class="screen">
  <div class="glow script">Happy Birthday</div>
  <div class="glow2 script">meri piyaru Malkin ✨</div>
  <button class="next" id="go">Open your surprise 💌</button>
</div>

<div id="feed">
  <section class="pg">
    <div class="vid" id="vbox">
      <video id="v" controls playsinline src="video.mp4"></video>
    </div>
    <div class="hint">swipe up ↑</div>
  </section>

  <section class="pg">
    <div class="letter">
      <h3 class="script">Meri Isuuu,</h3>
      <p>Happy Birthday meri jaan! 🎂 Aaj ka din sirf tumhara hai, kyunke tum meri life ki sabse khoobsurat cheez ho.</p>
      <p>Mujhe tumhari smile bohat pyari lagti hai, jab tum has deti ho to mera pura din ban jata hai.</p>
      <p>Mujhe tumhari care, tumhari baatein aur tumhara pyar se naraz hona bhi pyara lagta hai. Tum jaisi koi nahi.</p>
      <p>Tum mere sath ho to har mushkil aasan lagti hai. Thank you for being you, meri Malkin. 💕</p>
      <p style="text-align:right;color:#d6246e">Always yours ❤️</p>
    </div>
    <div class="hint">swipe up ↑</div>
  </section>

  <section class="pg wishes">
    <h2 class="script">Best Wishes</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>🌸 May every dream of yours come true</li>
      <li>✨ May your smile never fade</li>
      <li>💖 May you always be surrounded by love</li>
      <li>🎁 May this year bring you endless happiness</li>
    </ul>
    <div class="hint">one last swipe ↑</div>
  </section>

  <section class="pg end">
    <div class="glow script">I will always love you</div>
    <div class="glow2 script">meri Malkin 💞</div>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
const CODE="1110";let entry="";
const pad=document.getElementById("pad"),dots=[...document.querySelectorAll("#dots i")],msg=document.getElementById("msg");
["1","2","3","4","5","6","7","8","9","","0","⌫"].forEach(k=>{
  const b=document.createElement("button");b.textContent=k;
  if(!k)b.style.visibility="hidden";
  b.onclick=()=>press(k);pad.appendChild(b);
});
function draw(){dots.forEach((d,i)=>d.classList.toggle("f",i<entry.length))}
function press(k){
  if(k==="⌫")entry=entry.slice(0,-1);
  else if(entry.length<4)entry+=k;
  draw();msg.textContent="";
  if(entry.length===4){
    if(entry===CODE){setTimeout(unlock,250)}
    else{document.getElementById("dots").classList.add("shake");msg.textContent="Wrong code, try again 💭";
      setTimeout(()=>{document.getElementById("dots").classList.remove("shake");entry="";draw()},450)}
  }
}
function show(id){document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(s=>s.classList.remove("on"));document.getElementById(id).classList.add("on")}
function unlock(){show("hero");startMusic();hearts()}
document.getElementById("go").onclick=()=>{
  document.getElementById("hero").classList.remove("on");
  document.getElementById("feed").classList.add("on");
};
/* video fallback if no file */
const v=document.getElementById("v");
v.addEventListener("error",()=>{document.getElementById("vbox").innerHTML='<div style="padding:24px;color:#ffd1e8">🎥 Your video goes here</div>'});
v.addEventListener("play",()=>setVol(0));v.addEventListener("pause",()=>setVol(.5));v.addEventListener("ended",()=>setVol(.5));
/* hearts */
function hearts(){
  setInterval(()=>{
    const h=document.createElement("div");h.className="heart";
    h.textContent=["💖","💗","💕","✨","🌸"][Math.floor(Math.random()*5)];
    h.style.left=Math.random()*100+"vw";h.style.fontSize=(14+Math.random()*20)+"px";
    h.style.animationDuration=(5+Math.random()*5)+"s";
    document.body.appendChild(h);setTimeout(()=>h.remove(),10000);
  },500);
}
/* background song */
const song=new Audio("data:audio/mpeg;base64,");
song.loop=true;song.volume=.7;
function setVol(x){song.volume=x?.7:.03}
function startMusic(){song.play().catch(()=>{})}
</script>
</body>
</html>
